unlisted_practices: Examine training data and model outputs carefully to identify and eliminate potential biases in medical AI models.
Developers and healthcare professionals adopting AI should ensure that models are transparent and fair.
Use explainability methods such as class activation mapping or attention maps so clinicians can confirm a model attends to biologically relevant features.

screen.reason: This is a commentary discussing potential use cases (medical imaging and drug response prediction) and implementation challenges such as data generalisation and model explainability.
